item.title: ChimeraX atom specifications use a hierarchy of model, chain, residue, and atom
item.content: Common ChimeraX hierarchical atom-spec symbols are `#` for model, `/` for chain, `:` for residue, and `@` for atom.
item.explanationMarkdown:
Examples include:

```text
#1
/A
:45
@CA
#1/A:45@CA
```

The hierarchy lets commands target anything from an entire model down to a specific atom. A combined specification can therefore express a precise structural subset without first creating a separate object.

cards.question: Which ChimeraX atom-spec mapping is correct?
cards.explanation: ChimeraX hierarchical specifications use # model, / chain, : residue, and @ atom.
